leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize reactive state in a parent component to manage shared data.
Bind reactive state from a parent component to child components using props.
Implement custom event handlers in child components to emit changes.
Update parent state by handling custom events emitted from child components.
Control the flow of data by lifting state to the nearest common ancestor.
Render dynamic UI elements that reflect synchronized state across multiple components.
Manipulate the application structure to centralize state management for sibling components.
